next.reason: 1985: "<u>USE</u> [ <u>GLOBAL</u> ] <u>AFTER</u> STANDARD ... <u>PROCEDURE</u> ON"; 2023: "`AFTER`, `STANDARD`, `PROCEDURE`, and `ON` are printed without underlining.". Same Format 1 syntax otherwise, but 1985 underlines AFTER and PROCEDURE as required words. In 2023 they are not underlined, so they are optional and programs omitting them are now accepted.
